resources.string: Restart module scopes
Choose which system processes to restart and reload the module. Requires root.
Choose scopes to restart

Your choices will be remembered. Bluetooth scopes are available in debug builds only.

Restarting Bluetooth disconnects audio and connected devices briefly. Restarting System UI may hide the status bar and control center briefly. Only the selected processes are asked to restart, but Android may also restart dependent processes.

The app checks process identities and call status before restarting, then checks that the current module loaded. Optional Xiaomi Bluetooth UI may wait until it opens normally. No data is cleared and the phone is not rebooted. Cancel stops later steps; a restart already sent cannot be undone.
